title: spec + runtime: a package export carries no namespace and no dependencies, so a reinstalled .custom pair lands under the wrong namespace without its base edge; declare both on PackageExportManifestSchema and emit them
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Filing gate: ① the measured blocker of the #28914 server slice (os-dev-report `6589329364`, class b), anticipated by the #28914 spec slice's open question 3 (hand-off 6588925516, option A). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it (it blocks a p1).

## What happens

Measured on `origin/main` `81cd9eb0` through the real door (`HttpDispatcher` + protocol + ObjectQL on SQLite, the #29563 harness): a runtime holds a code base `com.example.showcase` and its pair `com.example.showcase.custom`, installed with `namespace: showcase_custom` and `dependencies: { com.example.showcase: ^1 }`, one dashboard override published.

- `GET /packages/com.example.showcase.custom/export` answers only `dashboards`, `id`, `name`, `version`. `namespace`, `dependencies` and `type` are absent; the registry row on the same runtime holds all of them.
- `assemblePackageManifest` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) does not emit them, and `PackageExportManifestSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` L183: `id`, `name`, `version`, `label` + catchall) does not declare them.
- Reinstall loses both: install-local falls back to `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` (gives `custom`) and reads `manifest.dependencies` for the ADR-0141 D5 install order and the ADR-0146 D2 override gate. `POST /packages` refuses the export outright (400: no `type`, flat collection keys).

So the whole-ontology export (#28914) cannot promise "installable packages" until each entry carries both.

## Wanted

- `PackageExportManifestSchema` declares `namespace` and `dependencies` as optional fixed keys (shapes as the install manifest's), and `assemblePackageManifest` emits them from the registry row **in the same change**, so neither key is declared and not produced.
- A round-trip pin: export a `.custom` pair, reinstall it through install-local, read back the same namespace and the base edge.
- `type` and the flat-collection refusal of `POST /packages` are out of scope (that door is not a reinstall door; adding `type` alone would not make it one). Name them in the PR as out of scope.
- Cross-domain (spec + runtime) in one PR, per the option the spec slice recorded; triage confirms the lane.

Serial: PR-level, beside #29373 (open, same schema, `withheldMaps`). #28914's server slice resumes on top of this card.

Dedupe: searched `PackageExportManifestSchema namespace dependencies`, `export manifest namespace dependencies reinstall`, `assemblePackageManifest namespace`; nearest #28914 (the consumer), #29373 (same schema, another key), #28404 (the pairing constants, closed). **New.**

Links back: #28914, PR #29100, #29373, #29563.
